_comment: JTE's own layer on top of the weekly market pull. salary-data.json is
overwritten every Saturday by the refresh, so anything we know that the
raw numbers do not must live HERE or it gets wiped.
scripts/resolve-salary.mjs merges this over the raw pull.

floor.appliesTo: Full-time basic monthly salary, Singapore, 5-day week
floor.short: Below about S$2,500 basic a month, a job gets much harder to fill.
floor.long: This is not a rule, just what we see. You can pay less. Expect to wait longer, and to lose people to the employer down the road. Everyone compares. For hands-on jobs on a 5-day week, S$2,500 is about where the market starts.
floor.exemptNote: The S$2,500 mark is about basic pay, where the basic is the whole package. Many hands-on jobs pay a lower basic with overtime on top. Judge those on the gross. Where we know both, we show both.

operative.label: Hands-on roles
operative.note: Two numbers matter for these jobs. The basic is what you promise. The gross is what they take home after overtime and allowances, and that is the one they compare with other employers. Supervisor jobs are listed on their own.

professional.label: Professional & executive roles
professional.note: Grouped by experience, because that is how employers ask us for people.

scope.label: Priced by scope

sub.Typical range: driven by how complex the work is

scope.note: Years matter less here. What matters is how much the job actually involves. Tell us the duties and we will tell you the number.

engineering.note: We price engineering by level, not by job title. There are too many titles, and two people with the same one can be paid a thousand dollars apart. What decides it is how technical the job is and how much it carries.

floor.appliesTo: Basic monthly salary, Singapore production and operator roles
floor.short: The basic is only half the story here. Aim for a gross around S$3,000.
floor.long: Production pay runs a lower basic than most sectors, with overtime and incentives making up the rest. S$1,800 basic is about the lowest anyone will take. S$2,000 is normal. S$2,200 to S$2,500 gets you noticeably better people. But the number they judge is the gross, and around S$3,000 wins them. Fewer people want heavy overtime now, so a package that only works with lots of OT is a hard sell.

manufacturing.note: The basic is only half the picture here. How simple or complex the job is moves the pay as much as the band does. At the bottom of the range, fewer people apply and the search takes longer.

floor.appliesTo: Base monthly salary, Singapore community care and support roles
floor.short: Care jobs run on bands, not one rate. Care staff starts around S$2,500.
floor.long: Care pay runs on bands. The entry level, a health attendant, starts at S$1,800. A healthcare assistant or care staff job starts around S$2,500 and goes to about S$3,200. Those are base figures, so overtime and shift allowances sit on top. Nursing is the one to watch. The base bands are real, but they are not what closes a hire. A clinic assistant already starts above S$2,500, and a nurse carries far more than that. Budget a starting gross of about S$3,000 or the job will stay open.

healthcare.note: Pay here depends on which band the job sits in, more than on years served. Tell us the duties and how much supervision there is, and we will tell you the band.

engineering/Engineering Technician.scope: Engineering assistant, technician, maintenance technician. ITE-level technical work.
engineering/Engineering Technician.basicNote: S$2,750 is where technical entry pay has landed. Below S$2,500 you will struggle to find good people. Allowances do not add much here, it depends on shift or non-shift.

logistics/Warehouse / Store.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026. Below S$2,500 basic is not the norm any more.
logistics/Warehouse / Store.aboveNote: Above this you are paying for a team leader or assistant supervisor. That is more responsibility, not a bigger job. We list it separately.

logistics/Driver.basicNote: Judge a driver package on the gross, not the basic. A low basic with good incentives is normal. How hard the run is moves the basic as much as experience does.
logistics/Driver.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026. Below this gross it is genuinely hard to attract drivers.

Basic.note: varies with how physically demanding the run is

logistics/Driver.benefitNote: Drivers can usually take the vehicle home. That is worth real money to them, and it often wins the hire.

Basic.note: S$2,200 to S$2,500 attracts better staff

Gross.note: with OT and incentives, this is the level that attracts

manufacturing/Production.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026, from 10+ years placing these roles.

manufacturing/Technician.basicNote: A broad title, so the job decides the number. We see clients paying S$2,700 and others S$2,800 for the same title, and S$3,200 with real experience. Manufacturing pays a little under engineering.

Typical range.note: scope drives this more than years do

manufacturing/Machine Operator.scope: Machine minding, loading, monitoring, basic checks.

Basic.note: S$2,200 to S$2,500 attracts better staff

Gross.note: with OT and incentives, this is the level that attracts

manufacturing/Machine Operator.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026, from 10+ years placing these roles.

manufacturing/Process._note: Reclassified from operative: the pay says this is a process specialist, not a line role. Confirm the right title with Eugene.

Basic.note: S$2,200 to S$2,500 attracts better staff

Gross.note: with OT and incentives, this is the level that attracts

manufacturing/Assembly / Line.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026, from 10+ years placing these roles.

healthcare/Nurse.basicNote: These are what the market pays. A staff nurse can start lower, around S$2,730 base. But base is not what a nurse compares, and it is not what closes a hire. Shift and department allowances sit on top.

healthcare/Clinic Staff.scope: Front desk plus assisting the doctor, GP or dental.

Basic.note: around S$3,000 is the going rate

healthcare/Clinic Staff.basicNote: Starts above S$2,500, and about S$3,000 is the going rate. We placed one at S$2,800 basic, no allowances, 5 days and 44 hours, shifts but no midnight. Hiring is not the hard part. Keeping someone is.
healthcare/Clinic Staff.verifiedNote: JTE, Nov 2026, against placements we closed.

healthcare/Care / Support Staff.scope: Healthcare assistant and care staff. Certification needed, but easier to get than nursing.

Basic.note: start at the floor and expect a slow search

healthcare/Care / Support Staff.basicNote: Lower than nursing because the certification is easier to get. Do not read that as cheap. Even at S$2,500 this is a hard hire, so treat S$2,500 as the starting point, not the target. Allowances only apply when the job involves going out, so the basic is usually the whole package.

healthcare/Pharmacy.basicNote: This covers pharmacy jobs broadly, and the lower end is assistant and technician work. S$2,500 is the floor we would work to. A registered pharmacist starts much higher, from about S$3,850. Tell us which one you need.

Typical range.note: data entry at the low end, full office support at the top

commercial/Admin / Secretarial.basicNote: How complex the job is decides this, not years. Simple data entry sits near the bottom. A job that actually runs the office sits near the top.

healthcare/Enrolled Nurse.basicNote: Base only, and the base is the problem. S$2,050 will not attract anyone now. A clinic assistant already starts above S$2,500, and a nurse carries far more than that. Budget about S$3,000 starting gross with allowances in, or expect a long search.

Typical range.note: scales with who you are supporting and what you are trusted with

commercial/Secretary.basicNote: A different job from admin support, not a step up from it. The top of this range is for someone supporting senior leadership.

engineering/Engineer.scope: Mechanical, electrical, design, process, site, project, civil and structural, QA and QC.

Typical range.note: complexity and responsibility decide where in the range

engineering/Engineer.basicNote: The discipline matters less than you would think. What moves the number is how technical the job is and how much it carries. A complex brief pays more than a simple one with the same title.

engineering/Senior Engineer.scope: Senior mechanical, senior design, lead engineer and equivalent.

Typical range.note: industry and company move this as much as years do

engineering/Senior Engineer.basicNote: Experience gets you into this range, but it does not set the number. The industry and the company do. The same senior title pays very differently across the two.

basic.label: basic monthly
basic.note: Basic monthly salary, before bonus, AWS, overtime and allowances.

gross.label: gross monthly
gross.note: Gross monthly package, basic plus overtime, incentives and allowances. For some roles the basic on its own is not what someone takes home, and not what they compare.
